sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
<title id="title">Anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
<desc id="desc">An animated SVG of a cheerful anteater in a circus hat, pedaling a unicycle and juggling three bottles.</desc>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87ceeb"/><stop offset="70%" stop-color="#cdeffd"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fff3c4"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e6c98a"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b8935a"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="bottleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2ecc71"/><stop offset="50%" stop-color="#27ae60"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#145a32"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="bottleGrad2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f39c12"/><stop offset="50%" stop-color="#e67e22"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a04000"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="bottleGrad3" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9b59b6"/><stop offset="50%" stop-color="#8e44ad"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4a235a"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <clipPath id="bodyClip"><ellipse cx="385" cy="305" rx="92" ry="54" transform="rotate(-12 385 305)"/></clipPath>

  <!-- Bottle symbol, origin at centre -->
  <g id="bottle1">
    <rect x="-14" y="-34" width="28" height="68" rx="9" fill="url(#bottleGrad)" stroke="#0e4d26" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-7" y="-48" width="14" height="18" rx="4" fill="#1e8449" stroke="#0e4d26" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-8" y="-56" width="16" height="10" rx="3" fill="#d5b25a" stroke="#8a6d2b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="-14" y="-8" width="28" height="20" fill="#fdf6d8" opacity=".92"/>
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="bold" fill="#7d6608">★</text>
    <rect x="-9" y="-28" width="5" height="52" rx="2.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".35"/>
  </g>
  <g id="bottle2">
    <rect x="-14" y="-34" width="28" height="68" rx="9" fill="url(#bottleGrad2)" stroke="#7e5109" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-7" y="-48" width="14" height="18" rx="4" fill="#d35400" stroke="#7e5109" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-8" y="-56" width="16" height="10" rx="3" fill="#d5b25a" stroke="#8a6d2b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="-14" y="-8" width="28" height="20" fill="#fdf6d8" opacity=".92"/>
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="bold" fill="#7d6608">★</text>
    <rect x="-9" y="-28" width="5" height="52" rx="2.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".35"/>
  </g>
  <g id="bottle3">
    <rect x="-14" y="-34" width="28" height="68" rx="9" fill="url(#bottleGrad3)" stroke="#2e1150" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-7" y="-48" width="14" height="18" rx="4" fill="#7d3c98" stroke="#2e1150" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-8" y="-56" width="16" height="10" rx="3" fill="#d5b25a" stroke="#8a6d2b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="-14" y="-8" width="28" height="20" fill="#fdf6d8" opacity=".92"/>
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="bold" fill="#7d6608">★</text>
    <rect x="-9" y="-28" width="5" height="52" rx="2.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".35"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Juggling loop: left hand -> high arc -> right hand -> low return -->
  <path id="jugglePath" d="M 430 255 Q 385 55 495 255 Q 470 315 430 255 Z"/>
  <path id="jugglePath2" d="M 495 255 Q 450 55 560 255 Q 535 315 495 255 Z" opacity="0"/>
</defs>

<style>
  .wheel-spin { animation: spin 1.1s linear infinite; transform-origin: 400px 465px; }
  .pedal-spin { animation: spin 1.1s linear infinite; transform-origin: 400px 465px; }
  .pedal-spin-rev { animation: spinRev 1.1s linear infinite; transform-origin: 400px 465px; }
  .bob { animation: bob .55s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .tail { animation: wag .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 310px 305px; }
  .tongue { animation: flick .6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 575px 285px; }
  .ear { animation: wiggle .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 465px 215px; }
  .armL { animation: armL .6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 455px 295px; }
  .armR { animation: armR .6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 465px 300px; }
  .hat { animation: hatBob .55s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .cloud1 { animation: drift 14s linear infinite; }
  .cloud2 { animation: drift 22s linear infinite; }
  .cloud3 { animation: drift 18s linear infinite; }
  .road { animation: roadMove .7s linear infinite; }
  .blink { animation: blink 3.5s infinite; transform-origin: 500px 245px; }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes spinRev { to { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
  @keyframes bob { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(-7px); } }
  @keyframes wag { from { transform: rotate(-7deg); } to { transform: rotate(8deg); } }
  @keyframes flick { from { transform: scaleX(.45); } to { transform: scaleX(1.15); } }
  @keyframes wiggle { from { transform: rotate(-4deg); } to { transform: rotate(7deg); } }
  @keyframes armL { from { transform: rotate(-6deg); } to { transform: rotate(9deg); } }
  @keyframes armR { from { transform: rotate(8deg); } to { transform: rotate(-7deg); } }
  @keyframes hatBob { from { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-2deg); } to { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(2deg); } }
  @keyframes drift { from { transform: translateX(850px); } to { transform: translateX(-250px); } }
  @keyframes roadMove { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-80px); } }
  @keyframes blink { 0%,92%,100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 95% { transform: scaleY(.1); } }
</style>

<!-- Background -->
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#sky)"/>
<circle cx="105" cy="90" r="52" fill="#ffdf6b" opacity=".95"/>
<circle cx="105" cy="90" r="68" fill="#ffdf6b" opacity=".25"/>
<circle cx="105" cy="90" r="84" fill="#ffdf6b" opacity=".12"/>

<!-- Clouds -->
<g fill="#fff" opacity=".95">
  <g class="cloud1"><ellipse cx="0" cy="110" rx="55" ry="26"/><ellipse cx="38" cy="98" rx="38" ry="22"/><ellipse cx="-42" cy="100" rx="32" ry="18"/></g>
  <g class="cloud2"><ellipse cx="0" cy="70" rx="45" ry="20"/><ellipse cx="32" cy="60" rx="30" ry="16"/><ellipse cx="-32" cy="62" rx="24" ry="14"/></g>
  <g class="cloud3"><ellipse cx="0" cy="170" rx="38" ry="16"/><ellipse cx="26" cy="162" rx="24" ry="12"/></g>
</g>

<!-- Distant hills & trees -->
<path d="M0 470 Q150 390 300 450 T600 440 T800 460 V600 H0Z" fill="#7fc97f" opacity=".8"/>
<path d="M0 500 Q200 440 400 485 T800 480 V600 H0Z" fill="#5cb35c"/>

<!-- Ground & road -->
<rect y="510" width="800" height="90" fill="#e8c87a"/>

Created animated SVG at `anteater.svg`:

- **Anteater**: tan body with dark stripes, long snout with flicking pink tongue, bushy wagging tail, blinking eye, and circus hat/bow-tie; bobs while pedaling
- **Unicycle**: spinning spoked wheel, rotating crank/pedals with legs synced to pedaling, red frame and saddle
- **Juggling**: 3 colored bottles (green, orange, purple with labels/corks) tumbling along a shared cascade loop via `animateMotion` + rotation, offset timing, with animated juggling arms/hands
- **Animation**: CSS `@keyframes` for bobbing, tail-wag, tongue-flick, ear-wiggle, wheel spin, drifting clouds, moving road dashes, and blinking, plus SMIL for bottles/confetti

Open `anteater.svg` in any browser to see the animation.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
